phase_name: Apply part-scoped repair to baier_katoen_2008 and venema_1993

objectives.description: Review the Phase 5 dry-run diff for baier_katoen_2008 in detail before writing
objectives.note: Sampled 8 of the newly-resolved control_char/absent occurrences (random.seed(42) over the 88 candidates), printed PDF ground-truth context alongside the located markdown gap for each. All 8 showed a clean, unambiguous alignment (control-char-corrupted negation immediately adjacent to the expected base character, matching the PDF's rendered mark placement). One base_char class ('|', representing the corpus's own two-character '|=' rendering of the models/satisfies turnstile) was specifically re-checked against Phase 4's finding: confirmed via grep that both the uncorrupted positive form ('TS |= P', hundreds of occurrences) and the already-repaired negated form ('∤=', 115 pre-existing occurrences from earlier phases) are the corpus's own established convention -- validating that these repairs are semantically correct, not a compound-base defect Phase 4 already ruled out.

objectives.description: Run --write over baier_katoen_2008; confirm backup with sha256 manifest and post-write word/byte delta verification on all 12 part files
objectives.note: 70 occurrences written across 10 files (part02-part11; part01/part12 had no accepted edits this round). 0 refused (backup failure), 0 rolled back (post-write verification failure). All 12 part files have a verified sha256 manifest entry under $LITERATURE_DIR/.backups/combining-repair-2026-07-27/ (backups for part01/12 pre-exist from having no edits needed; part02-11 newly backed up or already present from an earlier same-day repair -- the rollback-target fix from Phase 2 correctly used THIS invocation's own captured pre-edit read as the delta baseline throughout, per the NOTE lines the script printed for files with a stale day-start backup).

objectives.description: Run --write over venema_1993 across its 9 secNN_*.md section files, same verification
objectives.note: 0 proposed rewrites, 0 files written -- exactly the outcome Phase 5's dry-run predicted (venema_1993 was byte-identical before/after the scoping code change, corpus-wide-verified). Not a failure: venema simply has no occurrences whose ambiguity Phase 5's scoping resolved. No backup was needed since no file required a write.

objectives.description: Re-run the detector over both documents and record the new residual counts
objectives.note: Idempotence confirmed: a second --write run over both directories proposed 0 rewrites in both. baier_katoen_2008 residual ledger: 469 (pre-Phase-5) -> 398 (post-Phase-5-code, pre-write) -> 395 (post-write). The extra -3 beyond the 70 written occurrences is `overlapping_edit` dropping from 15 to 12 -- fixing some occurrences shrank adjacent gap text enough to resolve 3 collisions between still-residual occurrences that shared an edit span before the write (a known, documented idempotence-supporting engine property, not a new defect). All other reason buckets (ambiguous_anchor 272, anchor_not_found 64, unrecognized_gap 43, narrow_failed 4) are unchanged from Phase 5's dry-run figures, confirming the write did exactly what the dry-run predicted. venema_1993: unchanged at 26 residual entries (0 write, 0 change).

objectives.description: Spot-check a sample of repaired passages against their cited pdf_char_offset to confirm the repaired reading matches the PDF ground truth
objectives.note: Re-scanned baier_katoen_2008 post-write and looked up the same 8 sampled PDF offsets from objective 1 by their pdf_char_offset key: 6/8 now classify as `precomposed` (repaired and accounted, matching PDF ground truth exactly -- e.g. offset 336260 base_char='|' PDF context '...Ai \u0338|= \u03a6 for...' now reads as the corpus's established '\u2224=' turnstile-negation convention). The remaining 2/8 (offsets 437140, 725822) are legitimately reported as `overlapping_edit` residuals (refused, not guessed at) -- confirmed via the post-write ledger, not silently dropped or mis-written. This is the safety contract working exactly as designed: refuse rather than guess when an edit span collides with another occurrence.
